name: Jigar Cables Limited
about: Jigar Cables Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of electric wires and cables under the SIGMA brand name in India. The company offers single core and multi core flexible, industrial power and control, submersible flat, ariel bunched, poly insulated submersible connection, and LT PVC and XLPE cables, as well as house wires, and MVCC and HT cables. It serves chemical and pharmaceutical, building and construction, shipping and marine, food and beverage, thermal power generation, petrochemical, automobile, petroleum refinery, steel plant, electronic, electrical, hotel and real estate, ginning, textile, cement, plastic, and mining industries; DGS&D mining; turnkey electrical contractors; and hospitals and railways, as well as the Port Trust of India. Jigar Cables Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Rajkot, India.
